Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller

Class ResearchDashboardController

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.web.controller.ResearchDashboardController
@Controller @RequestMapping("/research/runs") public class ResearchDashboardController extends Object
Thymeleaf controller that exposes the research run history UI.

Serves two pages:

  • GET /research/runs — lists all persisted ResearchRun records, newest first, in a table showing timestamp, truncated query, mode badge, and citation count.
  • GET /research/runs/{runId} — detail page for a single run; returns HTTP 404 if the run ID is not found.

Reads directly from ResearchRunPort — no application service layer is needed for these pure query operations that contain no business logic.

  • Method Details

    • listRuns

      @GetMapping public String listRuns(@RequestParam(required=false,defaultValue="timestamp_desc") String sort, org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      Renders the research run history list page.

      All persisted runs are fetched newest-first via ResearchRunPort.findAll(). Query strings longer than 80 characters are truncated with an ellipsis for display.

      Parameters:
      model - Thymeleaf model populated with the run list
      Returns:
      Thymeleaf view name "research-runs"

    • runDetail

      @GetMapping("/{runId}") public String runDetail(@PathVariable String runId, org.springframework.ui.Model model)
      Renders the detail page for a single research run.
      Parameters:
      runId - the UUID of the run to display (path variable)
      model - Thymeleaf model populated with the matched run and formatted timestamp
      Returns:
      Thymeleaf view name "research-run-detail"
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - HTTP 404 if no run with the given ID exists
